ResearchProjectDef.label: basic mending
ResearchProjectDef.description: Repair worn apparel and weapons at a simple, unpowered hand mending station. Working without power means working without any way to rebuild a component, so the hand station is limited to gear that does not contain one.

ResearchProjectDef.label: electrical mending
ResearchProjectDef.description: Upgrade to a powered electrical mending station: four times the speed of hand work, and no limit on what it can repair.

ResearchProjectDef.label: automated mending
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct a fully automated industrial repair center that mends items left on its input spots, with no colonist labor required.
